notes: Romero et al. 2007: iturin- and fengycin-family lipopeptides of Bacillus subtilis act against the melon powdery mildew fungus. Also called Podosphaera xanthii. MIBiG names this product iturin.
Romero et al. 2007, the same study as the iturin row. Also called Podosphaera xanthii.
Gu et al. 2017 (PMID 28733288): purified bacillomycin D inhibited F. graminearum (EC50 about 30 ug/ml) and reduced disease on wheat seedlings and heads.
Gu et al. 2017, the same study: tested on corn silks rather than whole plants, so a lower confidence than the wheat row.
Keel et al. 1992: a Tn5 mutant of Pseudomonas fluorescens CHA0 unable to make the compound suppressed take-all less well. The paper's name for the pathogen is Gaeumannomyces graminis var. tritici.
Hill et al. 1994 (PMID 16349167): pyrrolnitrin production by Pseudomonas fluorescens was linked to control of Rhizoctonia damping-off of cotton.
Howell and Stipanovic 1980: pyoluteorin as a seed treatment protected cotton seedlings; it was inactivated in soil. The paper's name for the pathogen is Pythium ultimum.
Xiao et al. 2023 (PMID 37118318): surfactin of over 98% purity inhibited B. cinerea (EC50 46.42 mg/L at 5 days) and reduced grey mould on harvested winter jujube.
